name: text-model-vision
description: 为非多模态模型提供看图能力的插件市场：通过千问视觉 API（DashScope）把图片转成文字描述。

description_i18n.en: Plugin marketplace that gives non-multimodal models vision: turns images into text descriptions via the Qwen vision API (DashScope).

plugins.name: text-model-vision
plugins.description: 为非多模态模型（如 DeepSeek）提供看图能力：通过本地脚本调用千问视觉 API（DashScope，OpenAI 兼容接口），把图片转成文字描述。

description_i18n.en: Gives non-multimodal models (e.g. DeepSeek) the ability to see images: a local script calls the Qwen vision API (DashScope, OpenAI-compatible) and returns a text description.
